verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a web API for programmatic access, covering organizations, teams, and data management/export. An official MCP server also exposes searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, and managing projects, but nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches everything the UI can do. The CLI is narrowly scoped to debug files, releases, and source maps, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard candidate paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, evidence of API coverage for dashboards, alerts and Seer features, a published machine-readable API spec, and independent hands-on confirmation.
